notes: Single source: LACO product page X-1P33958 (snapshot research/v5/cache/73755b639f2ae981.txt). Horizontal 17.5 in DIA x 24 in stainless cylinder with hinged front door carrying a 6 in viewport, and a rear machined bulkhead carrying 8 x DB25 + 4 x DB9 feedthroughs (8*25 + 4*9 = 236 pins). LN2-cooled pillow-plated cylindrical shroud, LN2 door shroud and LN2 platen, all rated -150 C (123.15 K); no heaters listed so no upper temperature. Platen slides out on a linear rail. Inside working envelope 16.0 in DIA x 22 in D, capacity up to 6U CubeSat. Pumping: 8.5 CFM dry scroll + high-vacuum turbo (turbo speed not published). Vacuum 1e-6 Torr; leak rate 1e-8 atm cc/s He. Other ports: NW16, NW25, NW40, ISO100, CF2.75, LN2 feedthrough. HVC-3500 controller with 7 in touch screen on the mobile cart. Cart/enclosure dimensions not published on this page or the sibling 18x24 chiller page (research/v5/cache/a4d07d242f93a9cc.txt); Tavily quota was exhausted so no wider brochure search was possible. The sibling chiller SKU lists a 16 in x 22 in platen, but that is a different system and was not carried over. For the 3D model: chamber diameter 17.5 in doubles as outer height because the cart height is unknown; the viewport is on the door at the cylinder's front end-cap, not the side wall.
